name: Maple Finance
description:
Maple is an onchain asset manager that activates capital through lending and trading. Lenders provide capital to underwritten strategies for yield opportunities, and institutional borrowers access capital from those strategies to fund and grow their businesses. The yield lenders receive comes from the interest those borrowers repay. Partners embed the same yield into their own products.

Through full market cycles since 2019, Maple has originated more than $25B in loans, manages $4.8B in assets, and has distributed more than $100M in yield back to lenders, with every position and transaction verifiable onchain.

Discover more at maple.finance. Onchain Capital. Activated.
